==Usage==
For articles considered part of the Legends continuity, include the parameter "legends" with any value. Example: <nowiki>{{ConjectureSpelling|legends=1}}</nowiki>.

For articles about real-world subjects, include the parameter "real" with any value. Example: <nowiki>{{ConjectureSpelling|real=1}}</nowiki>.
